description: Find Brazilian jiu-jitsu and grappling gyms by city, by country, or near a point. Give at least one of: city, country, or lat+lng. Returns at most 25 gyms per call (no pagination: narrow the area for more specific results). Each gym has a link to its public page on bjjsquare.com, where contacts and full details are shown. Use get_gym with the slug for the class schedule and what the gym offers.

city.description: City name, in the local language or in English (e.g. "Milano" or "Milan").

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. IT. Recommended with city, to avoid same-name cities.

lang.description: Language of the returned bjjsquare.com links: it, en, es, pt, fr or de. Default en.

radius_km.description: Search radius around lat/lng in km. Default 25, max 100.

name: find_gyms
title: Find BJJ gyms
